methodology_notes: This is a versioned published-statements snapshot, not signed source authentication.
2024/2025 container throughput is total-port TEU reported by media citing Morcenter, not unique paid Bering shipments.
2009 Rosmorrechflot registered capacity 45000 TEU is ARCHIVAL and not approved to represent 2026 available capacity.
Project design 30000 TEU (promoter) and 150000 TEU (GGE press) are not additive, commissioned, or comparable to annual total-port physical flow.
RUB 20.295bn government-program events vs RUB 37.655467bn promoter budget may overlap or differ in scope; difference is NOT a funding shortfall.
RUB 57.399m NPV and 21% IRR are unsupported promoter claims until model assumptions and valuation basis are inspected.
Corridor Mohe/Naiba tonnage is a secondary-reported proposal for multiple regions, not 2026 port throughput, container TEU, or paid Bering cargo.
Icebreaker season is conditionally determined by harbormaster; no proven cost/schedule delta for Bering.
One page display says last modified May 2026 while search index said October 2026: last-update metadata of promoter card has NOT been independently resolved.
0/96 original OD coverage is missing verification evidence, NOT zero physical shipments.
